look_here_first: Look for mostly leafless green jointed stems with branching at nodes; inspect tiny opposite scale leaves and separate male versus female seed cones.
photo_note: One species-specific licensed photo for a first-pass learner. Individual variation, complex taxonomy and exact anatomical traits await deeper visual and taxonomy review.
